milestones.text: Quantum-vulnerable digital signature algorithms (RSA, ECDSA, EdDSA) are deprecated after 2030.
milestones.provenance: CRYPTO-REVIEW-005 §2 (internal), read from the final PDF

milestones.text: Quantum-vulnerable digital signature algorithms (RSA, ECDSA, EdDSA) are disallowed after 2035.
milestones.provenance: CRYPTO-REVIEW-005 §2 (internal), read from the final PDF

milestones.text: Quantum-vulnerable key establishment (finite-field and elliptic-curve Diffie-Hellman, RSA) is deprecated after 2030.
milestones.provenance: CRYPTO-REVIEW-005 §2 (internal), read from the final PDF

milestones.text: Quantum-vulnerable key establishment (finite-field and elliptic-curve Diffie-Hellman, RSA) is disallowed after 2035.

milestones.text: Symmetric algorithms at the 112-bit security strength are disallowed after 2030.
